src_sentence: Mogul says critics say cow-worship has been politically manipulated by cow vigilante motivated by conservative BJP's majoritarian politics to harass minorities with allegations of disrespect of cows or cow slaughter.

src_sentence: In 1868, the British chocolate company Cadbury created Fancy Boxes – a decorated box of chocolates – in the shape of a heart for Valentine's Day. Boxes of filled chocolates quickly became associated with the holiday.

src_sentence: It was a rite connected to purification and health, and had only slight connection to fertility (as a part of health) and none to love.

src_sentence: In 2016, the Catholic Bishops of England and Wales established a novena prayer "to support single people seeking a spouse ahead of St Valentine's Day."

src_sentence: As the name indicates, this day is more about remembering friends, not significant others.

src_sentence: In Japan, the romantic "date night" associated with Valentine's Day is celebrated on Christmas Eve.

src_sentence: Couples exchange gifts, chocolates, cards, and flower bouquets.

src_sentence: Lupercalia was a festival local to the city of Rome.

src_sentence: No other record of the court exists, and none of those named in the charter were present at Mantes except Charles's queen, Isabeau of Bavaria, who may well have imagined it all while waiting out a plague.

src_sentence: In East Malaysia, the celebrations are much more tolerated among young Muslim couples, although some Islamic officials and Muslim activists from the West side have told younger generations to refrain from such celebration by organising da'wah and tried to spread their ban into the East.

src_sentence: In 2018, because of a petition by a citizen, Abdul Waheed, the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority advised broadcasters and newspapers against airing any Valentine's Day celebrations.

src_sentence: Saint Valentine's Day, or Ημέρα του Αγίου Βαλεντίνου in Greek tradition, was not associated with romantic love.

src_sentence: In Saudi Arabia, in 2002 and 2008, religious police banned the sale of all Valentine's Day items, telling shop workers to remove any red items, because the day is considered a Christian holiday.

src_sentence: Valentine of Terni became bishop of Interamna (now Terni, in central Italy) and is said to have been martyred during the persecution under Emperor Aurelian in 273. He is buried on the Via Flaminia, but in a different location from Valentine of Rome.
translation: Valentin de Terni devint évêque d'Interamna (aujourd'hui Terni, dans le centre de l'Italie) et aurait subi le martyre pendant la persécution sous l'empereur Aurélien (empereur romain) en 273. Il est enterré sur la Via Flaminia, mais à un endroit différent de Valentin de Rome.

src_sentence: The celebration of Saint Valentine is not known to have had any romantic connotations until Chaucer's poetry about "Valentine's Day" in the 14th century, some seven hundred years after celebration of Lupercalia is believed to have ceased.
translation: On ne sait pas si la célébration de saint Valentin a eu des connotations romantiques avant la Poésie de Chaucer sur la « Saint-Valentin » au XIVe siècle, quelque sept cents ans après la fin présumée de la célébration des Lupercales.

src_sentence: Additionally, there have been efforts to revive the ancient Persian festival of Sepandārmazgān, which takes place around the same time, to replace Valentine's Day. However, as of 2016, this has also been largely unsuccessful.

src_sentence: Jerusalem's Purification of the Blessed Virgin Mary on February 14 became the Presentation of Jesus at the Temple on February 2 as it was introduced to Rome and other places in the sixth century, after Gelasius I's time.
translation: La Chandeleur de Jérusalem le 14 février est devenue la Présentation de Jésus au Temple le 2 février lorsqu'elle a été introduite à Rome et dans d'autres endroits au VIe siècle, après l'époque de Gélase Ier.

src_sentence: In Taiwan, traditional Qixi Festival, Valentine's Day and White Day are all celebrated.
translation: À Taïwan, le Qixi traditionnel, la Saint-Valentin et le White Day sont tous célébrés.

src_sentence: Many parts of the Eastern Orthodox Church celebrate Saint Valentine's Day on July 6 in honor of Roman presbyter Saint Valentine, and on July 30 in honor of Hieromartyr Valentine, the Bishop of Interamna (modern Terni).
translation: De nombreuses régions de l'Église orthodoxe célèbrent la Saint-Valentin le 6 juillet en l'honneur du prêtre romain saint Valentin, et le 30 juillet en l'honneur du Hiéromartyr Valentin, évêque d'Interamna (l'actuelle Terni).

src_sentence: "For this was on seynt Valentynes dayWhan every foul cometh there to chese his makeOf every kynde that men thynke mayAnd that so huge a noyse gan they makeThat erthe, and eyr, and tre, and every lakeSo ful was, that unethe was there spaceFor me to stonde, so ful was al the place."
translation: « Car c'était le jour de la Saint-Valentin, quand chaque oiseau vient y choisir sa compagne, de toute espèce que l'on puisse imaginer, et ils faisaient un si grand bruit que la terre, l'air, l'arbre et chaque lac étaient si remplis qu'à peine y avait-il de la place pour que je me tienne debout, tant tout le lieu était plein. »

src_sentence: The practice of sending valentines originated in the Middle Ages, with no link to Lupercalia, with boys drawing the names of girls at random.

src_sentence: In Estonia, Valentine's Day was originally called valentinipäev and later also sõbrapäev ('Friend's Day') as a calque of the Finnish term.
translation: En Estonie, la Saint-Valentin s'appelait à l'origine valentinipäev, puis aussi sõbrapäev (« le jour des amis ») par calque du terme finnois.

src_sentence: The feast day of Saint Valentine is given in the calendar of saints of the Lutheran Church.
translation: La fête de saint Valentin figure dans le calendrier des saints du Luthéranisme.
